title: Good reduction and finite endomorphism descent
source_locator: Part I Theorem 12.1(a), p. 55; Theorem 10.15, p. 49; Proposition 10.20, p. 50; Lemma 14.5, p. 63; Part IV Theorem 3.5, pp. 141-142 and Lemma 3.9, p. 143.
objects_and_maps: W0=Res_K/Q A, geometric End lattice rank≤16F0²; Galois kernel E; L=EK.
hypotheses_and_discharge: Consumes the earlier finite-etale cover and good reduction construction and the restriction-of-scalars abelian variety W0.
conventions: Unramified versus good reduction: prime-to-residue coefficient prime; action on ordered conjugacy Hom comes via End(W0), not arbitrary labels.
translation_justification: Milne I.10.15 bounds integral endomorphism rank; a finite basis descends over a finite extension. A finite-order integral action congruent to identity mod 3 has eigenvalues 1 by I.14.5 and is semisimple in characteristic zero, so reduction modulo 3 is faithful. NOS and unramified induction show inertia acts trivially on Tate and hence End away from T. Passing to EK fixes the factor labels and all ordered Hom groups.
